quarterly_data.signal: Investor presentation (Citi 2026 Taiwan Corporate Day, March 9, 2026), NT$ million: 2025 quarterly revenue 2,297 (1Q25), 1,522 (2Q25), 1,804 (3Q25) and 2,234 (4Q25), and net income 613, 205, 372 and 483; January and February 2026 revenue 886 and 873. 2025: top 10 customers 87% of revenue; North America 67%, Taiwan 15%, China 13%, others 5%; by product coaxial sockets 43%, probe cards 29%, contact elements 11%, RF and plastic sockets 9%, burn-in sockets 4%, others 4%; MEMS probe cards were 21% of 2025 vertical probe card revenue (NT$2307M), with the MEMS share of the Cobra / MEMS mix at 90% in Q4 2025. Spring-probe capacity plan of 5M units a month rising to 8M in Q3 2026 and 11M in Q4 2026; Renwu Facility I completed in March 2026 with production from April and May 2026; Renwu Facility II covers about 6,300 ping (about 20,826 m2). The company puts SLT and SFT test growth for 2026-2030 at a CAGR above 15%.
